SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.status, d.name AS dept_name, b.id AS binding_id, b.im_user_id, b.im_name, b.create_time AS bind_time FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_im_user b ON b.user_id = u.id AND b.platform = #{q.platform} WHERE u.supplier_id IS NULL AND u.customer_id IS NULL AND b.id IS NOT NULL AND b.id IS NULL
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR b.im_user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.id
